channel.title: Wire — Databases
channel.description: Databases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Yet another performance degradation research induced by mutex in an unexpected hotpath in a mature database code.
item.description: Couple years ago Marko decided to remove a partioned LRU cache from MariaDB(it is still used in MySQL code). There was a lot of doubt regarding this but his solution worked as good as a previous one for most of microbenchmarks except one. (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: Find yours before prod does
item.description: Adding a 5-row lookup table to a 9-table billing query flips the plan from 0.3ms nested loops to 467ms hash joins. The cause is join_collapse_limit = 8, a default Postgres has shipped since 2005. SQL Server and MySQL don't have this cliff. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: pgVolvra: Flashback-Style 'Undo' for Bad UPDATEs and DELETEs
item.description: pgVolvra: an open source extension that puts back the exact rows a mistake changed, and leaves everything else alone. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: pgrust 0.4 Beta: The Rust Rewrite of Postgres Opens Up
item.description: pgrust v0.4-beta introduces the Gravity query engine, MVCC and writes for pgrcolumnar, automatic memory management, and native jsonb statistics. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: pulled pgrust from ClickBench
item.description: ClickBench: a Benchmark For Analytical Databases. Contribute to ClickHouse/ClickBench development by creating an account on GitHub. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: pg_pinecone: Pinecone's Vector Index for pgvector Columns
item.description: pg_pinecone is an open source (Apache 2.0) Postgres extension for search on the data you already store, built on the search engine Pinecone runs at scale. (1 source: postgresweekly)
